verdict.rationale: Twenty documents a built-in AI chatbot that answers natural-language questions about your CRM data and summarizes and explains records (docs-18, docs-69). It also documents AI agents that answer questions and enrich records (docs-5, docs-56), and opportunity scoring based on engagement patterns (docs-70), all inside the product. missing for 10: documented proactive suggestions or recommendations surfaced without being asked (only a thin scoring mention), and independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
